import concurrent.futures
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path('/home/jon/prog/retorno_case/retorno')
label = sys.argv[1]
out = Path('/tmp/retorno-e4-' + label)
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(root / 'src') + ':' + str(root), RETORNO_SAVE_DIR=str(out / 'saves'))
paths = sorted(set(root.glob('tests/*smoke*.py')))
def run(path):
    start = time.monotonic()
    try:
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(path)], cwd=root, env=env, text=True,
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=240)
        result = dict(file=path.name, code=p.returncode, seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start, 2))
        (out / (path.stem + '.log')).write_text(p.stdout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        result = dict(file=path.name, code='timeout', seconds=240)
        (out / (path.stem + '.log')).write_bytes(exc.stdout or b'')
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
    return result
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 4) as pool:
    results = list(pool.map(run, paths))
(out / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
print('TOTAL', len(results), 'FAIL', sum(r['code'] != 0 for r in results), flush=True)
